question:
What did you mean when you put "Re:" in the title?
I see it from time to time, but I don't really understand it.
answer:
I don't really know about "Re:" in other works, but in my work, "Re:" is envisioned like an email reply.
When replying to an untitled email with no title, it gets sent with nothing but "Re:" in the blank subject line; like that, it carries the image of "returning with only the memory of looping back on a clean slate".
Well, if you tell me that makes no sense, I apologize (lol).
